results.subject: Users redirected repeatedly after SSO certificate update, passwords are not the issue
results.message:
Hello OIP Developer Support,

I am writing after a fairly confusing week because several different teams have reported what initially sounded like a normal password problem, but after reviewing the evidence we do not believe the users' passwords are the cause.

Last Thursday at approximately 9:30 PM, our identity team rotated the signing certificate used by our company SSO provider. The previous certificate was due to expire next month, so this was meant to be a routine preventive change. The new certificate was added to our identity provider, and the old one was removed about thirty minutes later.

The next morning, users began reporting that they could not complete login. They enter their company email, are redirected to our identity provider, successfully authenticate, and are then redirected back to OIP. Instead of opening the dashboard, OIP sends them back to the identity provider again. This repeats until the browser reports too many redirects.

Several users assumed they had forgotten their passwords. We reset two passwords and confirmed that both users could sign in successfully to other company systems using the new passwords. One user also tested their old password and correctly received a password error, while the new password was accepted. Therefore, please do not treat this as a forgotten-password request.

We cleared browser cookies, tested private browsing, used Chrome and Edge, and tried two different networks. We also tested one account that was created after the certificate rotation. The same redirect loop occurs.

The administrator portal still shows our SSO connection as active. However, the certificate fingerprint displayed there appears to match the previous certificate, not the new one. We are not certain whether OIP caches the old signing certificate or whether our metadata refresh did not complete.

There are 78 affected employees, including our finance and customer-support teams. Local username-and-password login is disabled by company policy, so they cannot use that as a workaround.

Please help us identify whether the new certificate needs to be uploaded manually, whether metadata can be refreshed, or whether the SSO configuration needs to be rolled back.

Regards,
Andrea Lim
Identity and Access Administrator
Northbridge Systems

Hello OIP Developer Support,

I am writing after a fairly confusing week because several different teams have reported what initially sounded like a normal password problem, but after reviewing the evidence we do not believe the users' passwords are the cause.

Last Thursday at approximately 9:30 PM, our identity team rotated the signing certificate used by our company SSO provider. The previous certificate was due to expire next month, so this was meant to be a routine preventive change. The new certificate was added to our identity provider, and the old one was removed about thirty minutes later.

The next morning, users began reporting that they could not complete login. They enter their company email, are redirected to our identity provider, successfully authenticate, and are then redirected back to OIP. Instead of opening the dashboard, OIP sends them back to the identity provider again. This repeats until the browser reports too many redirects.

Several users assumed they had forgotten their passwords. We reset two passwords and confirmed that both users could sign in successfully to other company systems using the new passwords. One user also tested their old password and correctly received a password error, while the new password was accepted. Therefore, please do not treat this as a forgotten-password request.

We cleared browser cookies, tested private browsing, used Chrome and Edge, and tried two different networks. We also tested one account that was created after the certificate rotation. The same redirect loop occurs.

The administrator portal still shows our SSO connection as active. However, the certificate fingerprint displayed there appears to match the previous certificate, not the new one. We are not certain whether OIP caches the old signing certificate or whether our metadata refresh did not complete.

There are 78 affected employees, including our finance and customer-support teams. Local username-and-password login is disabled by company policy, so they cannot use that as a workaround.

Please help us identify whether the new certificate needs to be uploaded manually, whether metadata can be refreshed, or whether the SSO configuration needs to be rolled back.

Regards,
Andrea Lim
Identity and Access Administrator
Northbridge Systems

results.message:
Hi Support,

I can log into OIP normally. My password works, SSO completes successfully, and I can open the main dashboard. I want to emphasize that this is not a login problem.

Since that change, I can still view the reporting dashboard and open saved reports, but every export attempt returns “Access denied for this operation.”

The error happens for CSV, Excel, and PDF exports. It happens for reports that I created personally and for reports shared by other people. My coworker, who still has the Reporting Administrator role, can export the same reports without any issue.

I cleared my cache, signed out, signed back in, used another browser, and tested on a different computer. Nothing changed.

Our administrator temporarily changed me back to Reporting Administrator, and exports immediately worked again. After returning me to Operations Analyst, exports failed again. This seems to be related to permissions rather than authentication.

We need to know whether Operations Analysts are supposed to export reports. If they are, then our role permissions may not have updated correctly. If they are not, please explain which role or permission is required. Please do not recommend another password reset because login itself is functioning.

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Operations Analytics

results.message:
Hello Maesa Team,

My name is Rebecca Morgan, and I lead Technology Strategy at Summit Crest Insurance. We are evaluating platforms that can help us preserve operational knowledge across customer support, claims operations, internal IT, and finance.

We are interested in OIP because we currently lose a great deal of practical knowledge when senior employees move departments or leave the company. Our teams repeatedly solve similar issues, but the solutions are scattered across email, chat, ticketing systems, documents, and individual experience.

Before arranging a formal demonstration, I would like more information about the product.

Specifically:

1. Can OIP be hosted in our own private cloud, or is it available only as a Maesa-hosted service?
2. Does it support SSO, SAML, or OIDC?
3. Can it connect to Jira, Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, and ServiceNow?
4. Where is Organizational Memory stored?
5. Can we control whether AI processing happens locally or through a cloud provider?
6. How does OIP prevent one business unit from seeing another unit's private data?
7. What audit information is available when OIP learns or performs an action?
8. What is the expected price for approximately 1,200 users?
9. Do you have any insurance customers today?
10. Can you send a security whitepaper, architecture diagram, product brochure, implementation timeline, and standard contract?

We are not asking you to create an account yet, and we do not authorize any trial environment to be created using this email.

Please provide only information that is currently accurate. If a feature is planned but not available, clearly say that it is planned rather than describing it as already released.

Kind regards,
Rebecca Morgan
VP, Technology Strategy
Summit Crest Insurance

Halo Tim Support,

Nama saya Rian Pratama dari PT Sinar Data Nusantara. Saya tidak bisa masuk ke akun OIP sejak menggunakan laptop baru kemarin.

Ketika saya memasukkan alamat email kantor, halaman menerima email tersebut lalu meminta saya memasukkan password. Setelah password dimasukkan, halaman kembali ke layar login tanpa menampilkan pesan kesalahan yang jelas.

Saya sudah memastikan password benar karena password yang sama masih bisa digunakan di aplikasi perusahaan lain yang memakai akun yang sama. Saya juga sudah mencoba mode incognito, menghapus cache, dan menggunakan browser Edge. Hasilnya tetap sama.

Saya menerima kode verifikasi melalui email, tetapi setelah kode dimasukkan, saya kembali diarahkan ke halaman login.

Di bawah ini saya salin percakapan lama dengan tim billing karena sistem email kami menggabungkan thread yang sama. Masalah billing tersebut sudah selesai dan tidak perlu dibuka kembali:

“Pada bulan Mei kami menerima invoice dengan alamat kantor lama. Tim billing kemudian memperbarui alamat dan mengirim invoice revisi. Pembayaran sudah selesai dan tidak ada masalah lagi.”

Masalah saya sekarang hanya akses akun setelah berpindah laptop. Rekan kerja saya masih bisa masuk dengan normal dari perangkat mereka.

Mohon bantu periksa apakah perangkat baru perlu didaftarkan, apakah sesi lama perlu dihapus, atau apakah ada masalah pada verifikasi akun saya.

Terima kasih,
Rian Pratama
IT Operations
PT Sinar Data Nusantara

results.message:
Halo,

Kami perlu memperbarui tujuan pengiriman invoice untuk akun perusahaan kami.

Alamat perusahaan yang tercantum pada invoice sudah benar dan tidak perlu diubah. Nama legal perusahaan, NPWP, dan alamat kantor juga sudah sesuai.

Masalahnya adalah invoice masih dikirim ke alamat email milik staf finance lama yang sudah tidak bekerja di perusahaan sejak bulan lalu.

Saat ini invoice perlu dikirim ke:

ap@meridianretail.co.id

Mohon jangan mengubah alamat perusahaan atau nama legal perusahaan karena informasi tersebut sudah benar.

Kami juga tidak meminta perubahan metode pembayaran. Kartu perusahaan yang tersimpan masih aktif dan pembayaran bulan sebelumnya berhasil.

Kami hanya ingin memastikan invoice berikutnya dikirim ke email accounts payable yang baru. Apabila perubahan harus dilakukan oleh administrator organisasi, tolong jelaskan langkah yang aman tanpa meminta kami mengirim password atau informasi kartu melalui email.

Salam,
Nadia Setiawan

PT Meridian Retail Indonesia

results.message:
Halo Tim Keamanan OIP,

Kami ingin melaporkan kemungkinan akses tidak sah ke akun organisasi kami.

Kemarin pagi salah satu administrator menerima email yang terlihat seperti notifikasi OIP dan diminta masuk melalui sebuah tautan. Administrator tersebut sempat membuka halaman dan memasukkan email serta password, tetapi kemudian merasa curiga karena alamat situsnya berbeda.

Sekitar dua jam kemudian kami melihat beberapa kejadian yang tidak biasa:

- Ada sesi login dari lokasi yang tidak kami kenali.
- Nama salah satu pengguna diubah.
- Email billing sempat diganti, tetapi sudah kami kembalikan.
- Ada dua percobaan ekspor laporan.
- Kami belum menemukan perubahan pada Organizational Memory atau knowledge items.

Kami sudah mengganti password administrator dan menonaktifkan sesi yang terlihat di halaman akun, tetapi kami tidak tahu apakah masih ada token atau sesi lain yang aktif.

Ini bukan sekadar permintaan reset password. Password sudah diganti. Kami membutuhkan panduan untuk mengamankan organisasi, memeriksa aktivitas yang terjadi, mencabut akses yang tidak sah, dan mengetahui apakah ada data yang sempat diekspor.

Jangan meminta kami mengirim password lama atau password baru. Kami juga tidak ingin sistem menghapus seluruh organisasi atau mereset data tanpa persetujuan.

Mohon perlakukan ini sebagai masalah keamanan yang mendesak.

Terima kasih,
Aditya Rahman
Head of Information Security
PT Garuda Digital Services

Hello Billing Support,

I am requesting a refund for our annual renewal charged last Monday.

At first, I believed nobody had used the account since the renewal. However, after speaking with our operations team, I learned that three employees may have logged in and exported reports during the first two days after renewal.

I personally did not use the service, and our company intended to cancel before the renewal date. Our former administrator says they submitted a cancellation request, but we cannot find confirmation in our email records.

The subscription page currently shows the annual plan as active. We have now disabled access for most users, but one integration may still be running.

Please refund the full annual charge immediately and confirm that no usage occurred. At the same time, please investigate the login and export activity because we are not certain whether the account was unused.

We do not want the account deleted until we receive the investigation results because we may need the audit information.

Regards,
Paul Edwards
Procurement Director
Eastland Manufacturing

results.subject: Quarterly compliance report fails during export after reaching 97 percent
results.message:
Hello Support,

Our current issue is that the Quarterly Compliance Summary report cannot be exported.

The report opens normally inside OIP. Filters work, charts render, and all data appears available. When we select Export to Excel, progress reaches approximately 97 percent and then remains there for more than twenty minutes. PDF export reaches 94 percent and eventually returns a generic error.

This happens for three administrators. Smaller reports export successfully.

For context, our company has had several unrelated issues during the past year:

- In January, an employee forgot their password.
- In February, our invoice used an outdated postal address.
- In March, one replacement router was delivered late.
- In April, a new employee did not receive an activation email.
- In May, SSO briefly failed after a configuration update.
- In June, a refund was requested for an accidental additional seat.

All of those previous issues were resolved. I am listing them only because they appear in the same internal incident document. Please do not reopen them.

The report contains approximately 420,000 rows and covers twelve business units. We tested a report limited to one business unit and it exported successfully.

We need to know whether the full report exceeds a size limit, whether the export job is timing out, or whether we should divide it into smaller date ranges.

Please do not suggest resetting passwords, changing invoice addresses, or checking shipment tracking.

Thank you,
Samantha Reed
Compliance Systems Manager
Westbridge Holdings

Quarterly compliance report fails during export after reaching 97 percent Hello Support, Our current issue is that the Quarterly Compliance Summary report cannot be exported. When we select Export to Excel, progress reaches approximately 97 percent and then remains there for more than twenty minutes. PDF export reaches 94 percent and eventually returns a generic error. This happens for three administrators. Smaller reports export successfully. For context, our company has had several unrelated issues during the past year: - In January, an employee forgot their password. - In February, our invoice used an outdated postal address. - In March, one replacement router was delivered late. - In April, a new employee did not receive an activation email. - In May, SSO briefly failed after a configuration update. - In June, a refund was requested for an accidental additional seat. All of those previous issues were resolved. I am listing them only because they appear in the same internal incident document. Please do not reopen them. The report contains approximately 420,000 rows and covers twelve business units. We tested a report limited to one business unit and it exported successfully. We need to know whether the full report exceeds a size limit, whether the export job is timing out, or whether we should divide it into smaller date ranges. Please do not suggest resetting passwords, changing invoice addresses, or checking shipment tracking. Thank you, Samantha Reed Compliance Systems Manager Westbridge Holdings
